Zeraora

Electric

Alola · Generation 7 · Mythical Pokémon

Zeraora is an Electric-type Thunderclap Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 44.5 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Speed (143), with a base stat total of 600.
